## Slider to matplotlib

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof num_points = Inputs.range([10, 200], {step: 10, value: 50, label: "Points"})
```

```{pyodide}
#| input:
#|   - num_points
#| edit: false
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

np.random.seed(42)
x = np.random.randn(int(num_points))
y = np.random.randn(int(num_points))

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6, 4))
ax.scatter(x, y, alpha=0.6)
ax.set_title(f"{int(num_points)} points")
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

## Dropdown


